body.note: Catalog is the real structure-template library (leap/structures.py), each decomposed to mass-balanced cut/fill primitives. Acceptance criteria are the real validate_plan checks (lode/planner_acceptance.py) with their default tolerances. The AS-BUILT pass/fail on the real terrain is a property of a planned mission and is read from the last /plan result (validation + ordered_acceptance), not stored server-side.
